long_biography.plain_text:
Robert Gerard inherited an operating business already shaped by two generations. His grandfather Alfred created the Clipsal electrical-accessories brand, while his father Geoff developed its plastics manufacturing and national distribution. When Gerard took charge in 1976, he pursued export markets and acquisitions, extending the company across Asia and into other international markets.

The family later sold the core Clipsal operation but kept a collection of other businesses. Gerard continued as chairman of a portfolio that included lighting, printing, logistics and property interests. He also guided a separately listed lighting group through its public-market phase, drawing on a career spent in electrical manufacturing. His industrial work was recognised through the Order of Australia for contributions to domestic and export industry.
